entities.name: Aruba
entities.note: Aruba is a territory of the Netherlands. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for the Netherlands.

entities.name: Anguilla
entities.note: Anguilla is a territory of the United Kingdom. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for the United Kingdom.

entities.name: Åland Islands
entities.note: Åland is an autonomous, Swedish-speaking, demilitarised region of Finland.

entities.name: American Samoa
entities.note: American Samoa is a territory of the United States. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for the United States.

entities.name: Bermuda

entities.name: Cook Islands
entities.note: The Cook Islands govern themselves in free association with New Zealand, whose citizenship islanders hold. A 2025 partnership deal with China strained that relationship.

entities.name: Curaçao
entities.note: Curaçao is a territory of the Netherlands. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for the Netherlands.

entities.name: Cayman Islands
entities.note: Cayman Is. is a territory of the United Kingdom. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for the United Kingdom.

entities.name: Western Sahara
entities.note: Western Sahara is a disputed territory. Morocco controls most of it and calls it its southern provinces; the Polisario Front, backed by Algeria, claims it as the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic. The UN still lists it as a non-self-governing territory.

entities.name: Falkland Islands
entities.note: The Falkland Islands are a self-governing British overseas territory, also claimed by Argentina, which lost a war over them in 1982.

entities.name: Faroe Islands
entities.note: Faeroe Is. is a territory of Denmark. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for Denmark.

entities.name: Guernsey
entities.note: Guernsey is a territory of the United Kingdom. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for the United Kingdom.

entities.name: Greenland
entities.note: Greenland is a self-governing part of the Kingdom of Denmark, with its own parliament and control over most domestic affairs. Copenhagen still runs its defence and foreign policy, which is why Trump's talk of buying or taking it lands on Denmark's desk.

entities.name: Guam
entities.note: Guam is a territory of the United States. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for the United States.

entities.name: Hong Kong
entities.note: Hong Kong is a special administrative region of China. The 'one country, two systems' arrangement promised it autonomy until 2047, but the 2020 National Security Law brought it firmly under Beijing's political control.

entities.name: Heard Island and McDonald Islands
entities.note: Heard I. and McDonald Is. is a territory of Australia. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for Australia.

entities.name: Isle of Man

entities.name: Jersey
entities.note: Jersey is a territory of the United Kingdom. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for the United Kingdom.

entities.name: Macau
entities.note: Macao is a special administrative region of China and the world's biggest gambling hub by revenue. It has been governed closely in line with Beijing since its handover from Portugal in 1999.

entities.name: Saint Martin
entities.note: St-Martin is a territory of France. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for France.

entities.name: Northern Mariana Islands

entities.name: Montserrat
entities.note: Montserrat is a territory of the United Kingdom. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for the United Kingdom.

entities.name: New Caledonia
entities.note: New Caledonia is a French overseas collectivity in the Pacific, rich in nickel. Deadly riots in 2024 over voting rules reopened the long fight over independence between the Indigenous Kanak and settlers' descendants.

entities.name: Norfolk Island
entities.note: Norfolk Island is a territory of Australia. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for Australia.

entities.name: Niue
entities.note: Niue is a self-governing island in free association with New Zealand, with about 1,700 residents and far more Niueans living in New Zealand.

entities.name: Pitcairn Islands
entities.note: Pitcairn Is. is a territory of the United Kingdom. It doesn't get its own write-up; its politics run through the entry for the United Kingdom.

entities.name: Puerto Rico
entities.note: Puerto Rico is a US territory. Its 3.2 million people are US citizens but have no vote for president and only a non-voting delegate in Congress, and the island's status (statehood, independence or the current arrangement) is still argued over.
